zh-CN.title: AI 爆款视频分段复刻 By 灵途 AI
zh-CN.description: 将源视频按语义分段，用 Wan3.0 逐段重绘、确认并合成爆款复刻视频。
zh-CN.prompt: 把这段视频按语义切成不超过 15 秒的片段，用 Wan3.0 逐段重绘，每段让我确认。
zh-CN.input: 源视频、改编要求及可选人物照片、声音或台词。
zh-CN.output: 分段重绘视频、逐段确认记录与最终合成视频。
zh-CN.requirement: 生成需要配置 LINGTU_API_KEY；转写和视频处理依赖按工作流检查，每段确认后继续。
highlights: 按语义拆分最多 15 秒的参考片段
使用 Wan3.0 逐段重绘与确认
按源视频顺序合成，可恢复任务

en-US.title: LINGTU Video Remake
en-US.description: Split a source video into semantic segments, regenerate them with Wan3.0, review, and merge.
en-US.prompt: Split this video into semantic segments of up to 15 seconds and regenerate each with Wan3.0 for my approval.
en-US.input: Source video, adaptation requirements, and optional portrait, voice, or dialogue references.
en-US.output: Regenerated segments, review records, and a merged video.
en-US.requirement: Generation requires LINGTU_API_KEY. Check transcription and video-processing dependencies; approve each segment before continuing.
highlights: Split reference footage into segments of up to 15 seconds
Regenerate and review each segment with Wan3.0
Merge in source order and resume saved tasks
